  --results-csv scripts/thesis/script_2_thesis/ensemble_backtests/results/20260621_095337_phase3_cross_fold_transfer_promise/xfer_block_a_tcn_f1_promise_top3_off_to_f3/results.csv \

  --output-md scripts/thesis/script_2_thesis/ensemble_backtests/results/20260621_095337_phase3_cross_fold_transfer_promise/xfer_block_a_tcn_f1_promise_top3_off_to_f3/report.md

    How To Read It

    • source rows are the baseline references for the selected trials.
    • source_baseline_mode=original_stage3 means the runner compared against the original stage-3 backtests.
    • source_baseline_mode=rerun means the runner reran the source trials on the execution range.
    • ensemble rows are the new synthetic executions.
    • In the pairwise comparison table, positive Delta PnL means the ensemble beat that source trial.
    • Negative Delta Trades means the ensemble traded less than that source trial.

    Selection Context

    • Planner mode: fixed_trials_canonical_scoring
    • Fold: F3
    • Tier filter: ALL
    • Model filter: tcn
    • Top per model: 3
    • Rank by: promise
    • Compatibility bucket symbol / timeframe: BTCUSDT / 5m
    • Compatibility bucket experiment type: trading
    • Compatibility bucket candidate count: 45
    • Compatibility bucket selected count: 3
    • Compatibility bucket models: tcn
    • Compatibility bucket source runs: 20260328_tierB_corrected, 20260401_tierB_rescue_v5
    • Compatibility bucket total selection score: 253.34595959595958
    • Group selection rule: Fixed-trial validation execution from batch JSON. The requested source trials were preserved exactly, then enriched with canonical planner scores reconstructed from source fold F1.

    Legend:

    • #: Row number within the table.
    • Code: Compact Script 2 experiment code.
    • Tier: Feature-tier group used by the experiment.
    • Model: Model family or model type.
    • Fold: Temporal fold used for validation or backtesting.
    • Sel Rank: Source-trial selection rank from the planning stage.
    • Sel Score: Planner score used to select the source trial.
    • Obj: Optuna objective value.
    • S1: Stage-1 score component.
    • S2: Stage-2 score component.
    • S3: Stage-3 score component.
    • PnL (Ret%): Net profit/loss with return percentage.
    • Total Fric: Estimated total friction cost.
    • Total Gross PnL: Gross PnL proxy before friction.
    • Net/trade: Net PnL divided by trade count.
    • Gross/trade: Gross PnL divided by trade count.
    • Positive Edge Retention%: Share of gross positive edge retained after friction.
    • Benchmark RC (Ret%): Risk-constrained benchmark PnL and return.
    • α (RC): Risk-constrained alpha versus benchmark.
    • Benchmark (Ret%): Unconstrained buy-and-hold benchmark PnL and return: 100% of initial equity held long over the full execution range, no risk constraints. Used to compute α (adj).
    • α (adj): Legacy friction-adjusted alpha: gross PnL return (pre-friction) minus the unconstrained buy-and-hold benchmark return (100% equity, no risk constraints).
    • Trades (Entry%): Executed Stage3 trade count; Entry% is the Stage3 model entry-signal rate: the percentage of total Stage3 predictions where the model emitted an entry signal before bot logic.
    • Win%: Winning-trade percentage.
    • Sharpe: Backtest Sharpe ratio.
    • Investor MTM Max DD%: Investor MTM maximum drawdown as a fraction of the peak equity at the drawdown (max_drawdown / running peak).
    • Sortino Daily: Annualized daily Sortino ratio: mean UTC daily MTM return over downside deviation below zero, scaled by sqrt(365).
    • Calmar: Calmar ratio: annualized MTM return divided by the absolute investor MTM max drawdown percentage.
    • Profit Factor Net: Sum of positive net trade PnL divided by the absolute sum of negative net trade PnL.
    • Fees/Gross PnL: Total fees divided by the absolute gross PnL.
    • Turnover Ratio: Turnover notional divided by initial equity.
    • Capital Exposure: MTM position-notional-time integral divided by initial equity times session duration (average share of capital at risk).
    • Entry Total Block Rate: Total blocked entries divided by candidate directional signals.
    • Risk Force-Flat Rate: Risk force-flat closes divided by closed trades.
    • F1 Ent/Mac: Entry F1 and macro F1 scores.
    • JS Div: Jensen-Shannon divergence for prediction distribution drift.
    • Max Prob Corr: Largest class-probability correlation across NONE/LONG/SHORT: per diversity pair, or a trial's maximum against the other selected trials. Higher means more redundant predictions.
    • Max Signal Agr: Largest signal-agreement fraction of a trial against the other selected trials. Higher means more redundant signals.
    • WS×Feat: Window size by feature-count profile.
    • Params: Trainable parameter count.
    • BT Prog%: Backtest completion percentage.
    • Run: Source run tag.
    • ExpID: Experiment database ID.
    • TrialID (Opt#): Trial ID with Optuna trial number when available.
    • BktID: Backtest session ID.

    Legend:

    • Ensemble: Ensemble row or merge rule being compared.
    • Source: Source trial baseline used for comparison.
    • Δ PnL: Change in net PnL between compared rows.
    • Δ Total Fric: Change in estimated total friction.
    • Δ Total Gross PnL: Change in gross PnL proxy.
    • Δ Net/trade: Change in net PnL per trade.
    • Δ Gross/trade: Change in gross PnL per trade.
    • Δ Positive Edge Retention%: Change in positive edge retained after friction.
    • Δ Ret%: Change in return percentage.
    • Δ Benchmark RC (Ret%): Change in risk-constrained benchmark PnL and return.
    • Δ α (RC): Change in risk-constrained alpha.
    • Delta Alpha RC vs Best Source: Candidate risk-constrained alpha minus the best-source risk-constrained alpha.
    • Alpha RC Improvement% vs Best Source: Alpha RC delta relative to the absolute best-source Alpha RC; NA when the source Alpha RC is null or zero.
    • Alpha RC Proportionality: Proportionality classification of Alpha RC improvement versus trade-count reduction.
    • Δ α (adj): Change in legacy friction-adjusted alpha between compared rows.
    • Δ Trades: Change in trade count.
    • Δ Win%: Change in winning-trade percentage.
    • Δ Sharpe: Change in Sharpe ratio.

    Legend:

    • Group: Dimension-value group being tested.
    • Cross-Fold Identity: Aggregation identity label: same_recipe_cross_fold, best_per_fold_policy, family_population, or ensemble_strategy. Cross-fold aggregates are never 'the same model' unless trained weights are identical.
    • Represented Folds: Ordered list of folds included in the aggregate.
    • Fold Coverage: Number of distinct folds represented by the aggregate identity.
    • Aggregate Net PnL: Sum of net PnL across represented folds.
    • Average Net PnL: Arithmetic mean of net PnL across represented folds.
    • Aggregate Return: Chronologically compounded strategy return across represented folds.
    • Aggregate Benchmark RC: Chronologically compounded risk-constrained benchmark return across represented folds.
    • Aggregate Alpha RC: Aggregate return minus aggregate benchmark RC (never the sum of per-fold Alpha RC values).
    • Average Alpha RC: Arithmetic mean of per-fold risk-constrained alpha.
    • Alpha RC Fold Wins: Count of represented folds with positive risk-constrained alpha.
    • Alpha RC Fold Win Rate: Alpha RC fold wins divided by fold coverage.

    Quick Takeaways

    • Best source baseline: source_trial_5719 with -$608.16.
    • Best ensemble rule: weighted_average with -$536.52.
    • Ensemble-vs-source pairwise wins on PnL: 21 / 24.
    • Ensemble-vs-source pairwise wins on Total Gross PnL: 18 / 24.
    • Best ensemble vs best source delta PnL: +$71.64.
    • Best ensemble vs best source delta Total Gross PnL: +$51.31.

    Appendix: Selection Notes

    T5719

    Trial 5719 (tcn, 20260401_tierB_rescue_v5) was selected for fold F1 with rank-by promise. Score=92.30. Main drivers: stage2=2.50, objective=1.43, win_rate=1.16. Obj=0.2751, S2=0.2923, S3=0.2404, PnL=-177, Trades=175, Sharpe=-0.96, WinRate=34.9%, AlphaRC=-0.0224. Fixed-trial validation reused the canonical planner score from source fold F1 for target execution fold F3.

    T3641

    Trial 3641 (tcn, 20260328_tierB_corrected) was selected for fold F1 with rank-by promise. Score=82.58. Main drivers: stage2=1.82, objective=1.47, sharpe=1.08. Obj=0.2751, S2=0.2776, S3=0.2468, PnL=-188, Trades=177, Sharpe=-0.97, WinRate=33.3%, AlphaRC=-0.0235. Fixed-trial validation reused the canonical planner score from source fold F1 for target execution fold F3.

    T5782

    Trial 5782 (tcn, 20260401_tierB_rescue_v5) was selected for fold F1 with rank-by promise. Score=78.47. Main drivers: stage2=1.53, objective=1.19, sharpe=1.16. Obj=0.2688, S2=0.2731, S3=0.2447, PnL=-129, Trades=148, Sharpe=-0.81, WinRate=33.1%, AlphaRC=-0.0176. Fixed-trial validation reused the canonical planner score from source fold F1 for target execution fold F3.
